result.topic_en: Draft notes on rational functions on an algebraic curve: if s₁, z₁ are rational functions of (s, z) related by an algebraic equation F₁(s₁, z₁) = 0, conditions under which s and z are conversely rational in s₁ and z₁ (birational transformation), together with remarks on Abelian integrals of the third kind with logarithmic singularities log(z − z₁)/(z − z₂).
